title: CitationTraverseInput
description: Input parameters for the citation-traverse subagent: a query, one or more seed papers, and traversal limits. Seeds are a list rather than a single paper because an integrated atlas's cell types are often defined in a contributing study, not in the atlas paper — seeding only on the atlas leaves the defining paper to chance, and inherited annotations measurably lose out when it does not come up. Where subatlas-consistency returns primacy 'subatlas_primary', that paper is seed priority 0 and the atlas follows it.

seeds.description: Papers to search at hop 0, in priority order. Legacy single-seed input via 'seed_paper_id' + 'seed_role' is still accepted; exactly one of the two forms must be given.

seed_paper_id.description: DEPRECATED single-seed form, retained so existing callers keep working: 'CorpusId:NNNN', 'DOI:10.xxxx/...', or 'PMID:...'. Prefer 'seeds'.

seed_role.description: Role stamped on hop-0 evidence for the single-seed form.

query.description: The search query that defines relevance for this traversal.

depth.description: Number of citation hops to follow (0 = seeds only).

k_per_paper.description: Max references followed per paper per hop (safety cap for hub papers, not the relevance filter).

run_cap.description: Max distinct papers searched across the whole run.

score_threshold.description: Optional coarse snippet-score floor applied before the sentence-level gate.

project_dir.description: Project directory. Required when any seed has retrieval 'local' — that is how the local snippet index is found.

output_dir.description: Directory to write traversal output files to.

role.description: What this paper IS relative to the corpus; stamped on the evidence it yields.

priority.description: Search order, 0 first. The defining paper goes first so its evidence is gathered before the run cap can bite.

retrieval.description: Where to search this paper. 'local' uses the project's own snippet index and is required for a corpus paper at status 'local' — ASTA holds too little of it to quote, which is why it was built locally. Read it from the paper's registry entry rather than guessing.

reason.description: Why this paper is a seed — e.g. 'subatlas_primary per subatlas_consistency.json: exact match, 0.71 contribution'. Recorded so a run's source ordering is auditable.
